messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: cassiopeia-dedicated-prod (eu-central-1) — high rate of 5xx on inference pods; priority: P1. Paging on-call SREs and infra.
Alice Chen: I'm responding, pulling recent kube events and pod logs now.
Bob Patel: I'll start investigating node memory and GPU errors. tagging infra-ops.
Alice Chen: quick triage: KV cache OOMs in llm-infer-1 replicas, causing controller restarts and 502s to customer traffic. Error snippet:
```
2026-03-17T19:02:43Z llm-infer-1 kubelet: eviction: memory available < 50Mi, killed process kv-cache (pid 4321)
2026-03-17T19:02:44Z gateway: upstream returned 502 for /v1/embeddings
```
Bob Patel: Confirmed noisy GC on g5x-16; memory pressure correlated with long-context customer jobs from Cassiopeia.
Maria Gomez: Can we failover traffic to standby cluster to reduce customer impact? What's the time to cutover?
Alice Chen: We can shift read-only (embeddings) traffic to standby in ~10 mins using routing policy — generation calls need model parity check.
Kevin Ortiz: Support / CS — Sophie, please prepare a tailored customer notice. We need to list impacted endpoints and guidance.
Sophie Liao: On it. Drafting short notice for Cassiopeia ops team. Suggest subject and body below, feel free to edit.
Sophie Liao: SUBJECT: Service degradation affecting dedicated inference (eu-central-1) — Cassiopeia
BODY: Hi Cassiopeia team,
We’re currently experiencing degraded performance and increased 5xx errors for your dedicated inference cluster in eu-central-1. Impact: embeddings and generation API calls may fail or be slower than normal. Our engineering team is actively mitigating by routing embeddings to the standby cluster and investigating KV cache memory pressure on the primary nodes.
Estimated customer impact: affecting ~12% of requests for your dedicated endpoint; timeouts/502s intermittent.
Immediate actions we recommend: retry on 5xx with exponential backoff; if you have high-priority jobs, pause batch runs until we confirm stabilization.
We’ll update you in 30 minutes or sooner with progress. Contact: Kevin Ortiz (support) — +1 555-0102, @Kevin Ortiz on Slack.
Sophie Liao: (end draft)
Maria Gomez: Looks good. Add note about SLA workarounds and that we’ll provide log bundle once stabilized.
Alice Chen: Operational plan: 1) Route embeddings to standby (in progress), 2) Increase pod memory limit + restart kv-cache (rolling restart), 3) If instability persists, perform controlled failover to standby cluster.
Alice Chen: Running routing change now: `rdwctl route update --service cassiopeia-dedicated --region eu-central-1 --prefer standby`
incident-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: change initiated by Alice Chen — routing weight: primary 30%, standby 70% (id: rc-664200A)
Bob Patel: Started rolling restart on llm-infer-1 podset with bumped memory request to 48Gi. Watchlist: pod restarts should not exceed 3 concurrent.
Alice Chen: Observation: error rate for embeddings dropped from 18% to 5% after routing change. Generation still at ~9% errors.
Kevin Ortiz: Sending the customer draft now and standing by for replies. Sophie — add this: if they request a callback, escalate to Maria.
Sophie Liao: Done. Email + Slack DM sent to Cassiopeia-ops@cassiopeia.com and slack @cassiopeia-ops. Copy of message attached: 
---
Hi Cassiopeia team — we’ve routed embeddings traffic to a standby cluster which has reduced error rates. Our engineers are still investigating generation errors tied to KV cache memory pressure. We’ll follow up with a stabilization ETA in 30 minutes.
---
Alice Chen: Quick internal note for status page (draft):
"We are investigating elevated 5xx errors for dedicated inference customers in eu-central-1. Impacted features: embeddings and text generation for dedicated clusters. Mitigation: partial traffic routing to standby clusters is reducing errors for embeddings; full mitigation in progress. Next update by 30 minutes."
Maria Gomez: Approve status page text. Also create a short incident summary for execs after handoff.
Bob Patel: Monitoring: set alert to notify if error rate >6% for 10m post-routing change.
Alice Chen: Handoff to daytime oncall in 25 mins — @Maria Gomez will take lead once I finish rolling restart.
Maria Gomez: Acknowledged, will take over and coordinate customer comms. Please attach current logs and runbook link.
Alice Chen: Logs and runbook: `s3://redwood-incident-logs/cassiopeia/6642001234/*.tgz`; runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-kv-cache.md
Kevin Ortiz: Routing/contact list for Cassiopeia (for support roster):
- Cassiopeia Billing: billing@cassiopeia.com (ops lead Emma R.)
- Primary ops: ops@cassiopeia.com (paging group)
- Engineering contact: eng-contacts@cassiopeia.com (on-call rotation)
- Slack workspace: @cassiopeia-ops (DM primary contact: @emmar)
If we need escalation: call Emma R. mobile +44 7700 900111.
Sophie Liao: Customer reply: "Thanks — we see embeds improving. Generation still failing for one job queue. Can you pause that queue from your side?"
Alice Chen: Can we identify the job? Bob, check active long-context sessions.
Bob Patel: Found one heavy job from cass-job-8874 using 100% kv-cache for 3 hosts. Requesting ops permission to kill.
Sophie Liao: Cassiopeia gave permission to pause job.
Alice Chen: Pausing job and restarting affected pods now.
incident-bot: ACTION: cassiopeia-job-8874 paused by Alice Chen (id: job-8874)
Alice Chen: After pause + restarts, generation error rate down to 2% and latency normalized.
Maria Gomez: Marking incident as mitigated. Preparing final customer follow-up with root cause and remediation steps.
Kevin Ortiz: Final customer follow-up template (short):
SUBJECT: Incident resolved — Dedicated inference degradation (eu-central-1)
BODY: Hi Cassiopeia team,
The issue has been mitigated. Root cause: KV cache memory pressure on dedicated g5x instances triggered OOM evictions for cache process, causing increased 5xx. Mitigation: we routed embeddings to standby, paused a large long-context job, and increased pod memory limits + rolling restarts. No data loss expected.
Post-incident actions: we will deploy a limit on long-context job quotas for dedicated tenants, add auto-eviction safeguards, and run a jobs audit with your team.
Apologies for the disruption — please reach out to Kevin Ortiz or Maria Gomez for a follow-up call.
Kevin Ortiz: Thanks team. Logging incident as SEV1-mitigated and creating postmortem ticket.
Maria Gomez: I'll take postmortem and coordinate with Cassiopeia for a post-incident review meeting.
Alice Chen: Closing my active tasks and handing off remaining artifacts to Maria.
Sophie Liao: Sent final message to customer. Cassiopeia acknowledged and asked for recommended rate limits configs — Maria, pls include in postmortem.
Maria Gomez: Will do. Closing thread."
